module TopModule (
  input clk,
  input in,
  input areset,
  output out
);

  reg [1:0] state = 2'b00; // Initial state is B

  always @(posedge clk or posedge areset) begin
    if (areset) begin
      state <= 2'b00; // Reset to B
    end else begin
      case (state)
        2'b00: begin
          if (in) begin
            state <= 2'b01; // Transition to A
          end else begin
            state <= 2'b00; // Stay in B
          end
        end
        2'b01: begin
          state <= 2'b00; // Transition to B
        end
        default: begin
          state <= 2'b00; // Default to B
        end
      endcase
    end
  end

  assign out = state; // Output the current state

endmodule

            $display("Data written: %0h", data_reg);

    end

);

module TopModule (
    input clk,
    input areset,
    input in,
    output out
);

    reg [1:0] state = 2'b00; // Initial state

    always @(posedge clk or posedge areset) begin
        if (areset) begin
            state <= 2'b00; // Reset to state B
        end else begin
            case (state)
                2'b00: begin
                    if (in) begin
                        state <= 2'b01; // Transition to state A
                    end else begin
                        state <= 2'b00; // Stay in state B
                    end
                end
                2'b01: begin
                    state <= 2'b10; // Transition to state B
                end
                2'b10: begin
                    state <= 2'b00; // Transition to state B
                end
            endcase
        end
    end

    assign out = state[0]; // Output is the first bit of the state

endmodule
